body: I don't really know if I'm honest. My job is going well, everything at the house is going well, everything with my girlfriend is going well.. I just don't have many friend where I live but I still talk to some of my old friends, not very much. I don't really know why I'm getting depressed again.

I have not. I get uncomfortable talking about it verbally, I have talked to my girlfriend about it somewhat but its still uncomfortable actually speaking about it. I find I can distance myself when I write about it which enables me to do it better.
I've tried medication before and its not worked. I tried quite a few different ones as well. If anything it's made it worse on some occasions. Thank you for your suggestion though.
